description: Phase 5: classical baselines B0-B4 required by the Fair Baseline Plan for C7 (K=4 raw, K=8 MA3 assets) and C8 (d=4 quantile, T=2, MA5), which Phase 3 did not run. Configuration only; compared with the quantum runs of sweeps S1 and S4 on the same machine.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T+1 windows; validation = last 12.5 % of the training split
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
evaluation.selection_rule: none: controls for LOG.md Phase 5 Comparison Plan
